name: Student Residence Permit (Öğrenci İkamet İzni)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires enrolment in an associate, bachelor's, master's, doctorate, or TUS/DUS specialty programme (or, for younger students, primary/secondary schooling without a family permit).
requirements.fix_path: Secure admission to a qualifying programme.

evidence_required.document: Health insurance (SGK if requested within 3 months of enrolment, otherwise private)

outcome.duration_length: period of study; 1-year renewable for primary/secondary

sources.title: Residence Permit Types - Presidency of Migration Management

notes: GENUINE PARTIAL-CREDIT MECHANIC confirmed, worth flagging distinctly: only HALF of student-permit time counts toward the 8-year long-term-residence clock — a real, specific discount not present on most other countree's student-to-PR pathways in this dataset (which typically either count fully or not at all, rather than at a fractional rate). Work rights limited: associate/undergraduate students can start work ONLY after completing the first year of study, and a work permit is still required even then — genuinely more restrictive than several other countries' student work-rights defaults in this dataset. A student can sponsor only spouse and children on this route, not other relatives. A 6-month post-graduation short-term permit bridges to work — the practical mechanism linking this route to tr_work_permit, closing Turkey's version of the core Journey chain seen throughout this dataset.
